draft.title: The world after 1945
card: The war in Europe ended in May 1945 with Germany's defeat. It ended in Asia in August and September 1945, after atomic bombs were dropped on Hiroshima and Nagasaki and Japan surrendered.
Germany lost its power as a state and was divided into zones run by the victorious Allies. Japan was occupied, led mainly by the United States.
The United Nations was founded in 1945 to keep peace between states. It was meant to do what the League of Nations had failed to do.
The United States and the Soviet Union came out of the war as the two strongest powers, called superpowers. They had very different political and economic systems, and they became rivals.
draft.remember: Germany and Japan were beaten, the UN was created, and two rival superpowers now led the world.

a.q: Which change best describes the shape of world power after 1945?
opts: Two superpowers, the United States and Soviet Union, led
Britain and France led the world as the strongest powers
Germany and Japan kept their power under new rulers
The United Nations took over the armies of all states
a.why: The war left the United States and Soviet Union far stronger than any other state, and they became rivals. Britain and France won the war, but they were not the leading powers, and the UN did not take over states' armies.
a.clue: Think about which two states emerged strongest.

b.q: A student says the United Nations was set up in 1945 only because the Allies had defeated Germany and Japan. Which statement best improves this?
opts: It was also meant to keep peace where the League had failed
It was set up by Germany and Japan to rebuild their states
It was set up to make the United States the only superpower
It was set up to end the rivalry between the two superpowers
b.why: The card says the UN was founded to keep peace between states, doing what the League of Nations had failed to do. It was not created to end superpower rivalry, which grew after the war, and it was not set up by the defeated states.
b.clue: Think about what problem the UN was meant to solve.

a.best: Two superpowers, the United States and Soviet Union, led

b.best: It was also meant to keep peace where the League had failed
